questions.stem: Starting from point A, a man walks 5 km North, then 3 km East, then 5 km South. How far is he from A and in which direction?
questions.explanation: A is correct. North 5 km then South 5 km cancel out. Net displacement: 3 km East. He is 3 km East of A.

questions.stem: A man walks 4 km South, then 3 km West. What is the straight-line distance from his starting point?
questions.explanation: A is correct. Using Pythagoras: √(4²+3²) = √(16+9) = √25 = 5 km. (3-4-5 right triangle)

questions.stem: Riya faces South. She turns 90° clockwise, then 45° anticlockwise. Which direction does she now face?
questions.explanation: A is correct. Start facing South. 90° clockwise (S→W) → West. 45° anticlockwise from West turns towards South → South-West.

questions.stem: At 6 PM, a man walks towards the setting sun (West). After walking 2 km, he turns right and walks 3 km, then turns right again and walks 4 km. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Start→2 km West (at -2,0). Turn right (North)→3 km North (at -2,3). Turn right (East)→4 km East (at 2,3). Distance from origin = √(2²+3²) = √(4+9) = √13 km.

questions.stem: Mohan starts from point P, walks 6 km North, turns right, walks 4 km, turns right, walks 6 km South, turns right, walks 2 km. How far is Mohan from P?
questions.explanation: B is correct. From P(0,0): 6N→(0,6). Turn right→East: 4E→(4,6). Turn right→South: 6S→(4,0). Turn right→West: 2W→(2,0). Distance from P(0,0) to (2,0) = 2 km East.

questions.stem: If South-East becomes North, North-East becomes West, what does North become?
questions.explanation: B is correct. SE→N: rotated 135° CCW. NE→W: also 135° CCW. Applying same rotation: N (0°) + 135° CCW = 135° from N = SW direction. South-West.

questions.stem: A boy walks 3 km East, then 4 km North. He then turns around (faces South-West) and walks to reach back to the starting point. What is the total distance walked?
questions.explanation: D is correct. He walks 3 km East + 4 km North = 7 km. Distance from start = √(3²+4²) = 5 km. He walks back 5 km. Total = 3+4+5 = 12 km.

questions.stem: Two friends A and B start from the same point. A walks 5 km North, B walks 5 km South. They then each walk 3 km West. How far apart are A and B?
questions.explanation: B is correct. A ends at (-3, 5); B ends at (-3, -5). Distance = √((−3−(−3))²+(5−(−5))²) = √(0+100) = 10 km.

questions.stem: A person facing North turns 135° clockwise. Which direction is he now facing?
questions.explanation: D is correct. North (0°) + 135° clockwise = 135° from North (clockwise) = South-East direction. N→NE(45°)→E(90°)→SE(135°). Facing South-East.

questions.stem: In the morning, a person was facing the sun. He turned 90° clockwise, walked, then turned 90° anticlockwise. Which direction is he now facing?
questions.explanation: A is correct. Morning sun rises in East, so person faces East initially. 90° CW → South. Then 90° CCW → East again. He faces East.
